# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
# How to safely test for the municipal water quality that should have been tested
3. Inspect the system water for visible contamination
4. Inspect for chlorine
5. Ensure that the water is being tested properly
6. Inspect all of the testing equipment that should have been tested
7. Inspect all of the testing equipment used to test for the correct chemical
8. Inspect the water for visible contamination to determine that it has not been contaminated
9. Inspect the water for visible contamination in a clear area of the system
10. Inspect the water from a clear area
11. Inspect the water from an empty area
12. Inspect the water from an area of the system that has been contaminated
13. Inspect for mold
14. Inspect for bacteria
15. Inspect for algae
16. Inspect for algae and test for bacteria and mold
17. Inspect for any type of mold
18.
